scenarios.title: Training triggers when another attacker has greater power
decisions: A declares Gryff Rider and Hill Giant as attackers against B.
The training trigger, if any, resolves; combat damage is dealt.

variants.label: greater_power
variants.expected: Hill Giant (power 3) is greater than Gryff Rider's power 2, so training triggers and Gryff Rider gets one +1/+1 counter (3/2). B takes 6 damage (life 14).

variants.label: equal_power
variants.delta: A declares Gryff Rider and Grizzly Bears (power 2) as attackers instead of Hill Giant.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears' power is not greater than Gryff Rider's, so training does not trigger. Gryff Rider has no counters. B takes 4 damage (life 16).

operation.unclassifiable: choice: a different attack declaration, which creature attacks beside the training creature

variants.label: attacks_alone
variants.delta: A declares Gryff Rider alone as an attacker.
variants.expected: No other creature attacks, so training does not trigger. B takes 2 damage (life 18).

operation.unclassifiable: choice: a different attack declaration, Gryff Rider attacks alone

detector.outcome: A training trigger fires when its creature attacks alongside another attacking creature with greater power.
detector.near_miss: A training trigger is evaluated for its creature attacking with no other attacker of greater power and does not fire.

scenarios.title: Each instance of training triggers separately
decisions: A declares Gryff Rider and Hill Giant as attackers against B.
Both training triggers of Gryff Rider resolve; combat damage is dealt.

variants.label: two_instances
variants.expected: Gryff Rider has its own training and one granted by Warrior's Resolve. Two training triggers fire and Gryff Rider gets two +1/+1 counters (4/3). Hill Giant's granted training does not trigger because Gryff Rider's power 2 is lower. B takes 7 damage (life 13).

variants.label: one_instance
variants.delta: Warrior's Resolve is on B's battlefield instead of A's, so Gryff Rider has only its own training.
variants.expected: One training trigger fires and Gryff Rider gets one +1/+1 counter (3/2). B takes 6 damage (life 14).

operation.unclassifiable: more than one fact: Warrior's Resolve is removed from A's battlefield and added to B's

scenarios.forge_notes: In the two_instances variant Warrior's Resolve also draws A a card at the beginning of the end step, because a creature with a +1/+1 counter attacked; that is why A's library holds a card. Warrior's Resolve under B's control does not affect A's creatures. Forge must count the granted instance separately from the printed one.

detector.outcome: Each training instance on an attacking creature fires its own trigger when the creature attacks alongside a creature with greater power.
detector.near_miss: A training trigger is evaluated for its creature attacking with no other attacker of greater power and does not fire.

scenarios.title: A 'when this creature trains' ability triggers when training puts a counter on it
decisions: A declares Savior of Ollenbock and Grizzly Bears as attackers against B.
Savior of Ollenbock's training trigger resolves; if Savior of Ollenbock trains, its 'trains' trigger targets Hill Giant.

variants.label: trains
variants.expected: Training puts a +1/+1 counter on Savior of Ollenbock (2/3), so the 'trains' trigger fires and exiles Hill Giant. B takes 4 damage (life 16).

variants.label: no_training
variants.delta: A declares Savior of Ollenbock and Fugitive Wizard (power 1) as attackers instead of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Fugitive Wizard's power is not greater than Savior of Ollenbock's power 1, so no training trigger and no 'trains' trigger. Hill Giant stays on the battlefield. B takes 2 damage (life 18).

operation.unclassifiable: choice: a different attack declaration, which creature attacks beside the training creature

detector.outcome: A trigger watching for its creature to train fires when training puts a counter on it.
detector.near_miss: The same trigger evaluated with fired false because no training happened.
